workflow_notes: Generate and editor-review S01 before using character/room anchor or ordering other ROOM_A shots.
Spend at most officially granted free credits, never subscription/trial/billing upgrades.
Free users may be throttled at 14:00-17:00 UTC; if throttled, do NOT start parallel providers or paid fallbacks.
Each generated video is candidate-only and must be preserved in the private Drive quarantine folder with exact filename.
Verify real MP4 SHA256, duration covering timecode, geometry, full FFmpeg decode, motion, face/identity, props, subtitles-safe, no unwanted audio/music, watermark and distribution terms.
No original media files in the public GitHub repository; no publication without explicit approval and rights verification.
